lead.t: Incisions made parallel to Langer's lines heal better and give narrower scars; those that cross them tend to gape and form hypertrophic scars or keloids. (On the face, follow the relaxed skin tension lines; across joints, avoid straight lines that cross flexor creases.)
lead.s: Basic Surgical Skills: Scrubbing, Sutures, Knots, Incisions, Diathermy and Drain
